title: Phineas Fisher: The Hacktivist Who Exposed Spyware and Got Away
excerpt: The story of Phineas Fisher, the elusive hacktivist who breached Gamma Group and Hacking Team, leaking 400GB of data and exposing global government surveillance. Learn how they did it, why they've never been caught, and the lasting impact on the spyware industry.
